Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 nullchk;
 -- make sure this unit was not already returned
 begin
 select 'x' into :GLOBAL.x
 from return_items
 where chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id
 and product_code = :ctrl_blk_2.product_code
 and aliquot = :ctrl_blk_2.aliquot and
 move_date is null;
 show_error_dist('5706');-- product already returned
 exception
 when no_data_found
 then
 null; -- unit not already returned
 when VALUE_ERROR
 then
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 when others
 then
 handle_error;
 end;
 -- make sure this unit was shipped from this blood center
 -- get latest shipment no for this unit
 begin
 select max(shipment_no),
 max(shipped_date)
 into :s_shipment_no,:s_shipment_date
 from shipped_products
 where chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id
 and product_code = :ctrl_blk_2.product_code
 and aliquot = :ctrl_blk_2.aliquot
 and stock_state = :g_stock_state_delevered;
 exception
 when no_data_found
 then
 IF :GLOBAL.code_scheme = 'I' THEN
 PREVIOUS_ITEM;
 END IF;
 show_error_dist('5702');-- Invalid aliquot, product was not shipped.
 when VALUE_ERROR
 then
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 when others
 then
 handle_error;
 end;
 -- also get, the coll_date,and inventory class
 begin
 select coll_date,inventory_class, osok_flag
 into :s_coll_date,:s_inventory_class, :osok_flag
 from shipped_products p
 where chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id
 and product_code = :ctrl_blk_2.product_code
 and aliquot = :ctrl_blk_2.aliquot
 and shipment_no = :s_shipment_no
 and p.stock_state = :g_stock_state_delevered;
 exception
 when no_data_found
 then
 IF :GLOBAL.code_scheme = 'I' THEN
 PREVIOUS_ITEM;
 END IF;
 show_error_dist('5702');-- Invalid aliquot, product was not shipped.
 when VALUE_ERROR
 then
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 when others
 then
 handle_error;
 end;
 -- make sure this unit was not already returned
 -- stock state = 'RT' in shipped products
 begin
 select distinct 'x' into :GLOBAL.x
 from shipped_products
 where chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id
 and product_code = :ctrl_blk_2.product_code
 and aliquot = :ctrl_blk_2.aliquot
 and coll_date = :s_coll_date
 and shipment_no = :s_shipment_no
 and stock_state != :g_returned_stock_state;
 exception
 when no_data_found
 then
 show_error_dist('5706');-- unit has already been returned
 when VALUE_ERROR
 then
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 when others
 then
 handle_error;
 end;
 -- make sure it is not already in discard products
 begin
 select 'x' into :GLOBAL.X
 from discard_products
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id
 and product_code = :ctrl_blk_2.product_code
 and aliquot = :ctrl_blk_2.aliquot
 and coll_date = :s_coll_date
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 :ctrl_blk_2.s_product_code := ' ';
 :ctrl_blk_2.product_code := ' ';
 :ctrl_blk_2.s_product_code_desc := ' ';
 show_error_dist('6300'); -- product has already been discarded.
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 null;
 when others
 then
 handle_error;
 end;
end;

procedure implement_return_policy is
 temp_return varchar2(1);
 t_credit varchar2(1);
 t_location_type varchar2(2);
 t_enforce varchar2(1);
 temp_date_out varchar2(1);
 accept_outdates varchar2(1);
 t_inventory_class varchar2(2);
 t_storage_class varchar2(2);
begin
 -- check if there are return reason code overrides
 -- that circumvent the normal return policy checks
 -- get_reason_codes; -- commented out by Amit (8/31/00) 
 -- Already done while validating return reason code
 -- enforce the decisions from the reason codes
 if :s_cr_ncr = :g_y
 then
 -- reason code indicates that credit is given for this
 -- type of return. check if we need to enforce the return
 -- policy
 if :s_enforce = :g_y
 then
 -- this is not to be implemented until jan 1 1995
 -- if ever, probably will be redone and driven by a table
 -- which is a better implementation
 -- enforce the return policy
 validate_return_policy(temp_return);
 -- determine if product is out of date
 if temp_return = 'Y'
 then
 -- passed partial policy check outdate policy
 IF :ctrl_blk_2.blood_type not in ('Mx','Mb','47','58')
 or :g_customer_type not in ('DI','RD')
 THEN
 validate_exp_date(temp_date_out);
 ELSE
 temp_date_out := 'N';
 END IF; 
 if temp_date_out = 'N'
 then
 -- product is not out of date, give customer credit
 :local.s_cr_db_ind := :g_give_credit;
 else
 -- product is out of date, check if blood center takes out of
 -- date products
 check_outdate_policy(accept_outdates);
 if accept_outdates = 'Y'
 then
 -- customer takes outdates, give them credit
 :local.s_cr_db_ind := :g_give_credit;
 else
 -- customer doesn't take outdates, dont give them credit
 :local.s_cr_db_ind := :g_give_no_credit;
 end if; --end to determine if customer gives credit for outdates
 end if; -- end of outdate checks
 else
 -- failed return policy, don't give customer credit
 :local.s_cr_db_ind := :g_give_no_credit;
 end if; -- end of enforcing return policy
 -- don't enforce the return policy
 elsif :s_enforce = :g_n
 then
 -- don't enforce the return policy but give the customer credit
 :local.s_cr_db_ind := :g_give_credit;
 else
 show_error_dist('3726'); -- invalid entry in validatation table vserv
 -- return reason codes, screw up
 end if;
 elsif :s_cr_ncr = :g_n
 then
 -- don't give customer credit
 -- don't enforce the return policy
 :local.s_cr_db_ind := :g_give_no_credit;
 else
 show_error_dist('3726'); -- invalid entry in validation
 -- return reason codes screw up
 end if;
 -- determine location of product and which tables to update
 --Discard / RD / BIO / NFT / Outdate products always go to discard
 IF :g_customer_type in ('DI','RD')
 or :ctrl_blk_2.blood_type in ('Mb','Mx','Mr','47','58')
 THEN
 :ctrl_blk_2.s_location_type := 'DI' ;
 END IF;
 -- If location type is quarantine
 if :ctrl_blk_2.s_location_type = :g_qu 
 then
 -- get quarantine location
 -- removed skc 11/4/94 if a quarantine and out date send to
 -- 'OUTDATE-BIN' else send to 'QUARANTINE-BIN'.
 -- instead of generating a quarantine location id
 -- get_location_id(:g_storage_class_qa);
 if :h_exp_date < sysdate then
 -- out of date, send to outdate location
 :ctrl_blk_2.s_location_id := 'OUTDATE-BIN';
 else
 :ctrl_blk_2.s_location_id := 'QUARANTINE';
 end if;
 :local.s_move_date := NULL;
 elsif :ctrl_blk_2.s_location_type = :g_re 
 then
 if :h_exp_date < sysdate 
 then
 -- out of date, send to outdate location
 :ctrl_blk_2.s_location_id := 'DISCARD-BIN';
 :local.s_move_date := NULL;
 else
 :g_stock_state := 'AV';
 product_checkin.get_inventory_class(
 :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id,
 :ctrl_blk_2.s_coll_date,
 :GLOBAL.chapter_id,
 :ctrl_blk_2.product_code,
 :ctrl_blk_2.aliquot, 'Y',
 :ctrl_blk_2.blood_type, :GLOBAL.code_scheme,
 t_inventory_class, t_storage_class); 
 get_location_id(t_storage_class);
 insert_active_products;
 :local.s_move_date := sysdate;
 end if;
 else 
 -- get discard location
 -- removed skc 11/4/94 put all discards into this bin
 -- instead of generating an discard location id
 --get_location_id(:g_storage_class_di);
 :ctrl_blk_2.s_location_id := 'DISCARD-BIN';
 :local.s_move_date := sysdate;
 insert_discard_products;
 end if;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: VALIDATE_RETURN_POLICY
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure validate_return_policy(temp_return out VARCHAR2) is
-- this procedure validates product type and any special
-- checks that accompany the blood center policy. if
-- any of those checks fail then return temp_return = 'N'
-- else temp_return 'Y';
temp_directed VARCHAR2(1); -- is this a directed doner
temp_life number; -- life left on product in dd.miss
temp_policy VARCHAR2(1); -- life left on product
temp_type VARCHAR2(1); -- is this a valid product type
temp_apheresis VARCHAR2(1); -- is this a valid product type
begin
 -- validate the product type is returnable
 -- if the product type is not returnable, then return to
 -- calling procedure and check the exp date for return policy
 begin
 temp_return := 'Y'; -- preset as returnable
 validate_product_type(temp_type);
 if temp_type = 'N'
 then
 temp_return := 'N';
 return;
 end if;
 end;
 -- implement special checks for RBC or PLT
 if :ctrl_blk_2.s_product_type like '%RBC%'
 or :ctrl_blk_2.s_product_type like '%PLT%'
 then
 -- must be RBC or PLT implement special checks
 -- make special check for apheresis platelet
 -- this apheresis platelet from next begin to first end
 -- is hardcoded and should be changed, currently
 -- we have no table look ups for this implementation
 -- so it returns either on its own with out checking the
 -- usual return policies.
 begin
 if :ctrl_blk_2.s_product_type = :g_apheresis_type and
 :ctrl_blk_2.product_code = :g_apheresis_code
 then
 -- need more generic info in tables
 validate_apheresis_plt(temp_apheresis);
 if temp_apheresis = 'N'
 then
 temp_return := 'N';
 return;
 end if;
 return;
 end if;
 end;
 begin
 -- is this a directed doner ?
 determine_if_directed_doner(temp_directed);
 if temp_directed = 'Y'
 then
 -- must be directed, does blood center take directed doner
 -- returns ?
 validate_directed(:ctrl_blk_2.s_product_type,
 temp_directed);
 if temp_directed = 'N'
 then
 -- directed doner, but blood center doesn't take directed
 -- returns, therefore fails return policy, check date
 temp_return := 'N';
 return;
end if; -- end of validation for directed doner
 end if; -- end of directed doner logic
 end;
 -- determine return policy in reference to product life at shipment
 begin
 -- get the product life in datetime at shipment
 determine_product_life(temp_life);
 -- determine if this product life is acceptable
 validate_product_life(:ctrl_blk_2.s_product_type,
 temp_life,temp_policy);
if temp_policy = 'N'
then
 temp_return := 'N';
 return;
end if;
 end;
end if; -- end of special RBC and PLT checks
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: VALIDATE_PRODUCT_LIFE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure validate_product_life(temp_prod_type in VARCHAR2,
 temp_life in number,
 pass_policy out VARCHAR2) is
-- Inputs : Product type, remaining life on the product at time of
-- shipping calculated by exp_date - shipment_date
-- the value is numeric dd.mmss. minutes and seconds
-- are the values after the decimal.
-- Output : 'Y' if product life falls within blood care accepted
-- return policy , 'N' others wise
-- For RBC's we are concerned about days:
-- EX: 7 days 1 hour is > 7 days so it fails the policy if
-- returnable days = 7 days
-- For PLT's we are concerned about huors:
policy_return_time number;
policy_price_return_time number;
temp_minutes number;
temp_hours number;
temp_days number;
begin
if temp_prod_type like '%RBC%'
then
-- get the acceptable returnable days for RBC's
 begin
 select rbc_returnable_days,rbc_reduced_price_days
 into policy_return_time,policy_price_return_time
 from chapters
 where chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+365);
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 pass_policy := 'N';
 show_error_dist('5333'); -- no hours defined for product type
 check_package_failure;
 when others
 then
 pass_policy := 'N';
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 -- compute remaining life on product in days
 temp_minutes := round(mod(temp_life,1)*60);
 temp_days := round(temp_life);
 if temp_minutes > 0
 then
 temp_days := temp_days + 1;
 end if;
 -- if remaining life on the product when it was shipped
 -- is greater than policy allowable then non returnable
 if temp_days >= policy_return_time or
 temp_days < policy_price_return_time
 then
 pass_policy := 'N';
 else
 pass_policy := 'Y';
 end if;
elsif :ctrl_blk_2.s_product_type like '%PLT%'
-- get the acceptable returnable hours for PLT's
then
 begin
 select plt_returnable_hrs
 into policy_return_time
 from chapters
 where chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+365);
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 pass_policy := 'N';
 show_error_dist('5333'); -- no hours defined for product type
 check_package_failure;
 when others
 then
 pass_policy := 'N';
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 -- compute remaining life on product in hours
 temp_minutes := round(mod(temp_life,1)*60);
 temp_hours := round(temp_life)*24;
 if temp_minutes > 0
 then
 temp_hours := temp_hours + 1;
 end if;
 -- if remaining life on the product when it was shipped
 -- is greater than policy allowable then non returnable
 if temp_hours >= policy_return_time
 then
 pass_policy := 'N';
 else
 pass_policy := 'Y';
 end if;
end if;
end;

procedure select_customer
 (entry in VARCHAR2, include in out VARCHAR2, exclude in out VARCHAR2,
 check_date in boolean, cust_id out VARCHAR2) is
 --
 -- this procedure allows user to select customer by entering a few
 -- leading characters of customer name, it will return the proper
 -- customer id or display a short list of matching customers
 --
 -- entry : user entry for search
 -- include : customer_types to be included
 -- exclute : customer_types to be excluded
 -- check_date : set for check of valid eff date
 -- cust_id : return customer_id
 --
 days number := 0;
 inlist VARCHAR2(20);
begin
 if entry is null
 then
return;
 end if;
 --
 -- set parameter for checking effective date
 if check_date = False
 then
 days := 3650;
 end if;
 --
 -- set up list of customer types to be included
 if include is null
 then
 inlist := 'AH,DI,EX,MG,RD,RG'; -- all customer types
 else
 inlist := include;
 end if;
 --
 -- set up list of customer types to be excluded
 if exclude is null
 then
 exclude := '0'; -- must have something in string
 end if;
 --
 -- first check if the id was entered then take it and be done
 begin
 select customer_id into cust_id
 from customers
 where customer_id = entry
 and instr(inlist,customer_type) > 0
 and instr(exclude,customer_type) = 0
 and chapter_id = :Global.chapter_id
 and nvl(return_accepted_flag,'Y') = 'Y' 
 and sysdate between eff_date-days
 and nvl(term_date+days,sysdate+1);
 exception
 when no_data_found
 then
 -- no match, try to match entry with customer name
 begin
 select customer_id into cust_id
 from customers
 where upper(name) like entry || '%'
 and instr(inlist,customer_type) > 0
 and instr(exclude,customer_type) = 0
 and nvl(return_accepted_flag,'Y') = 'Y'
 and chapter_id = :Global.chapter_id
 and sysdate between eff_date-days
 and nvl(term_date+days,sysdate+1);
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 show_error_dist('0302'); -- invalid customer
 check_package_failure;
 when TOO_MANY_ROWS
 then
 -- multiple matches, display short list and return null
 cust_id := '';
 list_values;
 end;
 end;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 tackle_error('Customers');
 check_package_failure;
end;
